auth_methods.quote: A personal access token (PAT) is the quickest and simplest way to authenticate in the API.
auth_methods.note: PAT (bearer), OAuth2 (bearer access tokens); Enterprise-only Service Accounts are also long-lived tokens (same class).

credential_access.quote: create a free account, or request a developer sandbox
credential_access.note: PATs are generated in the developer console of any account incl. free.

production_gate.quote: Make your app available to users in any Asana workspace, beyond your own organization or development environment
production_gate.note: Review needed to serve other workspaces via OAuth app.

api_type.quote: Asana apps use features like our rest API, app components, and webhooks.
api_type.note: App components/webhooks are not separate api types per rules.

mcp_official.quote: Asana offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI assistants and other applications to access the Asana Work Graph.

main_blocker_type.quote: Submitting your app for review is not required to obtain a token.
main_blocker_type.note: Self-serve PAT/OAuth; review only for multi-workspace distribution.
